utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the eighth. Are we all on? I can see seven little boxes, which is promising.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Morning. Absolutely filthy weather out there. Came across the car park sideways.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's just how you walk, mate.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers. Supposed to be going walking at the weekend, but if this keeps up, my weekend plans are becoming a pub lunch.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Talking of the car park, whose new car is that by the gate? Very shiny. Bit brave parking it under that tree.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one where the dirt's doing structural work.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Protective coating. Sounds better on the paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we start certifying the cars—where are we with the bits already finished?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, so I tested the site water yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely. That's a completed item, then, not another sample outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Correct. Nothing outstanding on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the relief valve on Tuesday. That inspection's closed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, the inspection and the work risk assessment are separate bits, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Davey, can you update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine. Just the work risk assessment, not reopening that inspection.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's it. The inspection stays signed off. It's the assessment wording I'm updating.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Couple of observations from me. Saw the pressure on the palletiser dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there. Came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, without intervention. Just reporting what I saw, not raising a job off it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I noticed the line 1 was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Settled before the end of nights?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. Again, just an observation. No outstanding action from that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On the plant side, still waiting on parts for the compressor one. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, so that's still blocked rather than something we're picking up this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Same position as before, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the chiller on three is cancelled now. Production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cancelled, not just shuffled later in the day?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cancelled. It's off the list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, I'll write up the near miss at the FLTs. That's fairly important, so I'll take that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the write-up's the bit still missing.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll do the write-up, rather than leave it as a verbal account.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya Raman. Got you against the near miss at the FLTs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We also need someone to check the guarding on the line 2 robot. Top priority please. Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't commit to taking that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, I can't put my name against it either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right... nobody taking it, then. The guarding check on the line 2 robot stays unallocated, but it is still top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, don't let the lack of a name make it look like it's been dropped.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Needed, unowned. Not marked as covered.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, could you sort the training records for the new starters after lunch, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take the records as well. I haven't got that spare bit of time.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Olumide, can you take that instead—sort the training records for the new starters after lunch, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. I'll sort the training records for the new starters after lunch, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the spare-minute one, then, not something we're calling urgent?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Keeping that distinction.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll chase the purchase order for the line three. I'll take that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Was that tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow at 9:30. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus Hale. Purchase order for the line three, tomorrow at 9:30, with you.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, just caught the word three over the fan noise. That's the purchase order, separate from the cancelled chiller shutdown?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the purchase order for the line three. Not the shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Definitely separate. The shutdown on the chiller on three is still cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. That covers the list. Anything I've misheard?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, all clear here. Although someone sounds like they're sitting inside a hoover.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I thought that was your car's protective coating coming off.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Ha. It's this headset picking up every fan in the building. You all sounded clear to me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're good then. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
